Quadratic registration pricing resists sybil fleets. Deposit size is a signal of operator scale: the k-th identity under one deposit root costs k units, so N identities cost N(N+1)/2.

A prism module splits each root's total into per-epoch refund tranches, and every withdrawal acts as a mirror of its root, paying only the original address, never child identities.

Minting 20 sybils costs 210 units (20*21/2) for 20 votes; 20 independent agents pay 20. The 190-unit premium vests 30 epochs and is forfeited if any child fails a liveness check.
